instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the Right Panel of the RecruitingJourney.js page.
Keep 'Follow-up' and 'AI Next Step' cards as they are (or slightly refined to match the new style).
Create a new 'CoachesCard' component that merges the coach list and engagement stats.
The 'CoachesCard' should have the Staff Change alert at the top (if active).
Each coach entry should show: Name, Health Badge (e.g. 'In Conversation' - Green, 'Going Cold' - Yellow), Role, Email.
The Health Badge colors should be: 'In Conversation': green, 'Going Cold': yellow, 'Closed': red, 'New': blue. Use 'badge-outline' variant or similar.
Add inline engagement stats (tiny icons) next to the email or below it for each coach if data permits. Use 'Mail' icon (opens) and 'MousePointerClick' (clicks).
The footer of the 'CoachesCard' must show the aggregate engagement stats: Email Opens (Green, #10b981), Link Clicks (Blue, #3b82f6), Unique Opens (Purple, #a855f7). Format as a 3-column grid.
Place the 'Share Profile' card at the bottom of the stack. Make it look like a CTA card.
Ensure the design works on desktop (fixed width ~350px) and mobile (full width).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons: Users, Mail, MousePointerClick, Eye, AlertTriangle, Share2, Plus, MoreHorizontal, AlertCircle.
Use existing 'Shadcn' UI primitives where possible (Badge, Button, Avatar, Separator).
